desc: Derive reduction: d=x-y divides N, N=d*(3y^2+3dy+d^2), d < N^(1/3) so d <= ~1e6.

Implement the single-loop solution: L = exact integer cuberoot(N); for d in 1..L, if N%d==0 compute M=N//d, D=12*M-3*d*d, check D>=0 and isqrt(D)^2==D, y=(-3*d+isqrt(D))//6, verify y>0 and d*(3*y^2+3*d*y+d^2)==N, output x=y+d and y.
Keep arithmetic fully exact (use math.isqrt, integer cube-root correction) to avoid float errors near 1e18.
Run the program on samples 397, 1, 39977273855577088 and confirm outputs match (12 11, -1, 342756 66212).
Test additional edge cases: N=1 (->-1), known difference 2^3-1^3=7 (->2 1), and small N with no solution.
